how_to_apply: Open the Combined Uniformed Services (Below Graduate Level) Examination, 2026 recruitment link.
Select the registration option and complete Basic Registration using the required personal information.
Verify the registered email address and mobile number through the prescribed OTP procedure.
Generate and securely retain the registration number and password.
Log in and open the Detailed Registration and application section.
Complete Personal Details, Other Details and Educational Qualification sections.
Provide relevant category, Odia language, driving licence, service and reservation details, where applicable.
Upload the prescribed educational and supporting documents.
Upload the required photograph, signature and left thumb impression using the specified formats.
Select the eligible posts in the required order of preference and choose the available examination district preferences.
Review the completed form and accept the declaration and undertaking.
Submit the application and pay the examination fee if applicable.
Check the final submission and payment status in Application History.
Download or print the submitted application for future reference.

Important: Candidates are entitled to submit only one online application. No modification or correction is permitted after final submission. Applicants should verify all information, documents and post preferences before confirming the application.

content_sections.heading: Odisha Police Constable Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must satisfy the minimum educational qualification, age, Odia language proficiency, physical fitness and other requirements relevant to their selected post. Qualification Notice: Constable (Communication) has additional subject-specific or diploma eligibility requirements. An ordinary Higher Secondary qualification without the prescribed subjects or equivalent technical qualification should not be assumed sufficient. Firefighting Driver: Candidates must possess a valid Heavy Motor Vehicle (HMV) driving licence by the prescribed cut-off date. Driver PMT: Candidates must possess a valid Light Motor Vehicle (LMV) or HMV driving licence as prescribed. Driving licence validity and the applicable vehicle category will be verified during recruitment. Candidates should refer to the exact driving conditions for their selected post.

content_sections.heading: Odisha Combined Uniformed Services Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The recruitment process includes a written examination followed by the applicable physical, driving, medical and verification stages. Written Examination. Physical Measurement (PM), qualifying in nature. Physical Efficiency Test (PET), qualifying in nature. Driving Test, where applicable. Medical Examination. Document and Certificate Verification. Preparation of the final selection list based on the prescribed post-wise merit criteria.

content_sections.heading: Odisha Police Constable Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The Common Written Examination is prescribed for all posts and consists of 100 multiple-choice questions for 100 marks , with a duration of 120 minutes. The examination carries negative marking of 0.25 marks for each incorrect answer . No marks will be awarded or deducted for unattended questions. Candidates applying for Constable (Communication) must appear in an additional examination based on +2 Science standards. A separate objective examination is prescribed for Firefighting Driver and Driver PMT posts.

content_sections.heading: Odisha Combined Uniformed Services Physical Standards 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the prescribed minimum height, weight and chest measurements applicable to their category. Physical Measurement is qualifying in nature.

content_sections.heading: Odisha Combined Uniformed Services Physical Efficiency Test 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates who qualify in Physical Measurement must complete the prescribed Physical Efficiency Test (PET). PET is qualifying in nature and does not directly contribute marks to the final comparative merit ranking. Additional events, including swimming, rope climbing and load carrying, are prescribed for certain Firefighter and Firefighting Driver candidates. Candidates should check the exact event applicability and performance standards in the official PET table. Ex-AgniVeers are exempted from the Physical Efficiency Test according to the notification, subject to the applicable eligibility conditions.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for OUSSSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Odisha Uniformed Services Staff Selection Commission (OUSSSC) to fill various uniformed services vacancies across the state of Odisha under advertisement number 01-CRE-2026/OUSSSC.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are announced in this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 7268 vacancies have been announced for various posts including Constable (Civil), Constable (Communication), Constable OISF, Firefighter, Firefighting Driver, Driver PMT, and Traffic Constable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the start date to apply online for OUSSSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online registration and submission of applications officially commenced on 23 October 2026. Eligible candidates can submit their forms through the official OUSSSC web portal before the closing date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the online application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of online applications as well as making the online fee payment is 12 November 2026. Applicants should apply well in advance to avoid last-minute server issues.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for general and backward class applicants?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/- for all applicants other than SC and ST categories, which can be paid securely through the online payment gateway using net banking, credit cards, debit cards, or UPI.

faq.question: Q6. Are SC and ST candidates required to pay the application fee?
faq.answer: No, candidates belonging to the Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) categories are completely exempted from paying the application fee as per the official notification guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for these posts?
faq.answer: The required qualifications range from passing the High School Certificate Examination (10th class) to Higher Secondary (+2) or a 3-year Diploma in engineering, depending on the specific post applied for.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for OUSSSC Various Posts 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Common Written Examination, Special Written Examination, Physical Standards Measurement and Physical Efficiency Test, Driving Test, Medical Examination, and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can candidates apply for this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online by visiting the official OUSSSC recruitment portal at https://ousssc.odisha.gov.in and completing the basic registration, detailed application form, and document uploading steps.

faq.question: Q10. What is the salary structure for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for various posts will be placed in the pay matrix Level-4 and Level-5 as per the Odisha Revised Scales of Pay (ORSP) Rules, 2017, along with applicable allowances.
